blocks.html: Robinsons Malls is bringing a feel of Baguio!

Rediscover their most interesting products like ube jam, peanut brittle, walis tambo, and many more as Robinsons Malls is bringing you the experience right here with its Old Baguio Market, a retail concept by Old Baguio Cafe located at the Upper Ground Atrium of Forum Robinsons which will run until March 1, 2021.

Get to see and purchase all your favorite items and delightful pasalubongs from the following top brands of Baguio City: Nardas, Easter Weaving Room, Kinwa Etnika Handicrafts, Mayat-an Handicrafts, Accents and Petals, Mondiguing Furniture, Vizcos Cakes, Teahouse Restaurant & Bakeshop, Good Shepherd, Tantamco’s Fine Products, Chocolate de batirol, Victoria Bakery, Ibay’s Silver Smith, Tam-awan Village, Baguio Country Club, Baguio Family, Dulche, Baguio Vegetables, Everything is Pine Manufacturing, Adeti’s Enterprise, Mommy La Food Products, Natural Metaphors Body Products, Highland Women’s Multipurpose Coop, Everything is Pure Manufacturing, ZTR Garlic Products, Ellebanna Aklang Handicrafts, and Carol Lines Ethnic and Fashion Accessories.
Feast your eyes with Baguio’s laidback and serene atmosphere, delicious food, and heritage all set in a spacious, clean and safe place at Forum Robinsons, Pioneer Street Mandaluyong City.

More exciting exhibits/shows await Robinsons Malls shoppers! Be updated, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like RobinsonsMalls on Facebook; follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter; and join their Viber Communities – Robinsons Malls Luzon for Luzon malls and Robinsons Malls VisMin for Visayas and Mindanao malls.
